presentationBanner.title: Brazil at the heart of Toulouse
presentationBanner.description: Come discover our unique flavors and warm atmosphere

text.title: Bossa Nova, a Brazilian vibe in the city center of Toulouse

content.0: Our cuisine is inspired by Brazilian traditions, rich in multiple influences: African, Indigenous, European... Each dish tells a piece of this mixed, generous and flavorful story.
content.1: The atmosphere, on the other hand, is inspired by botecos, those small popular bars in Brazil where you share a drink, some petiscos, a good caipirinha and a good time.

content.0: At Bossa Nova, music is part of the soul of the place.
content.1: From time to time, we organize live concerts to make the room vibrate to the rhythm of Brazil.
content.2: To know when the next concert will take place, be sure to follow us on social media.

presentationBanner.title: Discover our menu
presentationBanner.description: Authentic Brazilian dishes prepared with passion

description.0: Our menu consists of permanent dishes, but also of ephemeral suggestions that vary according to the season and arrivals. To discover these products of the moment, we invite you to check out our posts and our permanent stories on Instagram.
description.1: Here you will find the complete menu with all our fixed dishes.
description.2: In case of allergies, please let us know when you make your reservation.
